title: Version 1.4.0
html:
Version 1.4.0

March 10th, 2023

New Content:

  • Added new painting, supports image ids"
  • Added new chisel variants
  • Added arrow indicator to conveyors
  • Added tire item
  • Added a new island connected by a bridge
  • Added wanwood, deadwood, acacia, cactus, and mushrooms
  • Added support for sub-tracks to music and ambience
  • Added music to misc regions
  • Added a vanity trolley
  • Added fire and neon blocks
  • Added new light sources
  • Added garage door
  • Added new schematic types
  • Added water block
  • Added Kallostide
  • Added dice
  • Added new builder gamepass

Changes:

  • New behavior added to cheese
  • Advanced schematics are now a lightish red color
  • Reworked chisel behavior
  • Lowered sign and steel chisel price
  • Recolored sellner and joop grand barrow box colors
  • Doubled the schematic resize limit
  • Updated the moon texture
  • Tall Refined Axe is now in The Oak Depot
  • Increased the willow spawn rate

Bug Fixes:

  • Fixed ability to put rotated objects off property
  • Fixed music not listening to the slider
  • Fixed palm trees randomly rotating when growing
  • Rocks no longer consider property for spawning (such as sand, grass, etc)
  • Fixed magic wand box having the wrong texture
  • Misc random bug fixes that weren't logged
  • Fixed hatch not being able to be lifted
  • Fixed schematics being able to be filled by others without permission
  • Fixed trailer not being able to attach to vehicle in edge case
  • Fixed grabby grabber not disappearing it's bubble sometimes
  • Misc random bug fixes that weren't logged

Version 1.4.1

March 11th, 2023

Bug Fixes:

  • Fixed data loss issue from patch attempt

Version 1.4.2

March 13th, 2023

New Content:

  • Added new anchoring system to help prevent major lag issues
  • Added the ability to play solo
  • A new visitor has arrived...

Changes:

  • Reworked axe chopping to lock on to what you are hitting
  • Made the grabby grabber less slow and unusable
  • Temporarily disabled streaming enabled to test for client crashing issues
  • Lowered the value of cactuses

Bug Fixes:

  • Fixed issue with music transitions
  • Potentially fixed an issue with loading saves and the camera

Version 1.4.3

March 15th, 2023

Changes:

  • Increased sell value of Purple Cactus and Cactus

Bug Fixes:

  • Fixed items anchoring inside of trailers when on property
  • Fixed edge cases with anchoring (super weird)
  • Fixed camera loading issue
  • Fixed painting ID not working properly

Version 1.4.4

March 16th, 2023

New Content:

  • Added Irish NPC, go talk to him!
  • Added two new Saint Patrick's Day gifts
  • Added Clover trees for Saint Patrick's Day
  • Added greeb...
  • Added.. rainbows?

Changes:

  • Bridge puzzle is now 3 steps instead of 5
  • WMI Gramophone can now be toggled on and off

Version 1.4.4.847819

April 1st, 2023

New Content:

  • Added nukes
  • Added exclusive gurt egg
  • Added a certain boxed tall axe
  • Added Redwood tree to the 2nd island

Changes:

  • Added X and Z checks for ores in refineries
  • Different tier saws now have a difference
  • Fixed issues with grabby grabber being stuck in place

Version 1.4.5.847819

April 1st, 2023

Bug Fixes:

  • Fixed mobile not being able to interact
